scripts.check: npm run check:dashboard && npm run check:app && npm run check:tools && npm run check:ops
scripts.check:dashboard: npm --prefix finance-dashboard test && npm --prefix finance-dashboard run lint
scripts.check:app: npm --prefix finance-app test && npm --prefix finance-app run lint
scripts.check:tools: for file in actual-tools/*.js; do node --check "$file"; done && node --test actual-tools/test/*.test.js
scripts.check:ops: for file in ops/bin/*.sh; do bash -n "$file"; done && node --test ops/test/*.test.js
